--- title: "Geocoding divergence — unresolved facilities" subtitle: "Review copy: divergent facilities outside the hold range with no accepted coordinate, plus facilities with no location data at all" date: last-modified format: html: toc: true toc-depth: 3 code-fold: true page-layout: article execute: echo: true warning: false message: false --- ::: {.callout-note} This report was generated using AI under general human direction. At the time of generation, the contents have not been comprehensively reviewed by a human analyst. Working review copy of `geocoding-divergence.qmd`, focused on the facilities that `build_geocoded_all()` could not resolve. The pipeline-wired original (`geocoding-divergence.qmd`, target `geocoding_divergence_report`) continues to cover all divergent facilities. This copy reads the same live targets, so it reflects the current pipeline state each time it is rendered. ::: ## What "unresolved" means When Google Maps and the source coordinate (Vera Institute, Marshall Project, or the project's own geocoding) differ by more than 3 km, `build_geocoded_all()` refuses to pick a side: the facility's final `lat`/`lon` are left NA and the case is flagged for human review. Resolution means adding the facility's DETLOC to the appropriate group in `geocode_source_preference()` (`R/geocode.R`) — `google_maps`, `vera_institute`, `marshall_project`, or `manual` — and rerunning the pipeline. Hold rooms (IDs 2026–2189) are excluded from this copy. Their Marshall coordinates are a separate, larger backlog — they remain visible in the main divergence report. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(targets) library(dplyr) library(sf) library(leaflet) library(leaflet.extras) library(htmltools) library(knitr) source(here::here("add-carto-tiles.R")) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Source R/ functions so geocode_source_preference() is available tar_source() facilities_geocoded_all <- tar_read(facilities_geocoded_all) facility_roster <- tar_read(facility_roster) unresolved <- facilities_geocoded_all |> filter(divergent, is.na(lat) | is.na(lon)) |> left_join(facility_roster |> select(canonical_id, detloc, id_range), by = "canonical_id") |> filter(id_range != "hold") |> mutate( divergence_km = round(divergence_km, 1), search_label = paste0(canonical_name, " (", facility_city, ", ", facility_state, ")"), popup_html = paste0( "", htmlEscape(canonical_name), " (ID ", canonical_id, ifelse(is.na(detloc), "", paste0(" · ", detloc)), ")
", ifelse(is.na(facility_address), "", paste0(htmlEscape(facility_address), "
")), htmlEscape(facility_city), ", ", facility_state, ifelse(is.na(facility_zip), "", paste0(" ", facility_zip)), "
Source: ", source_name, "
Divergence: ", divergence_km, " km", "
Google: ", round(google_lat, 4), ", ", round(google_lon, 4), "
Source: ", round(source_lat, 4), ", ", round(source_lon, 4) ) ) ``` ::: All 1 unresolved divergences shown here come from the Vera Institute source (every one of these facilities has a Vera coordinate but no Google-agreeing one within 3 km). Hold-room divergences against Marshall coordinates are tracked in the main report. ## Map of unresolved divergences Each grey line connects the Google Maps geocode (blue) to the Vera/source coordinate (red). Unlike the main divergence report, all layers are shown by default — these facilities have no accepted coordinate yet. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} line_features <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(unresolved)), function(i) { row <- unresolved[i, ] st_linestring(matrix( c(row$google_lon, row$source_lon, row$google_lat, row$source_lat), ncol = 2 )) }) |> st_sfc(crs = 4326) leaflet(unresolved) |> addCartoTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |> addPolylines( data = st_sf(unresolved, geometry = line_features), color = "#333", weight = 3, opacity = 0.7, group = "Divergence lines", popup = ~popup_html ) |> addCircleMarkers( lng = ~google_lon, lat = ~google_lat, radius = 7, color = "steelblue", fillColor = "steelblue", fillOpacity = 0.8, weight = 1, opacity = 0.8, group = "Google", label = ~search_label, popup = ~popup_html ) |> addCircleMarkers( lng = ~source_lon, lat = ~source_lat, radius = 7, color = "firebrick", fillColor = "firebrick", fillOpacity = 0.8, weight = 1, opacity = 0.8, group = "Source (Vera)", label = ~search_label, popup = ~popup_html ) |> addLayersControl( overlayGroups = c("Divergence lines", "Google", "Source (Vera)"), options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE) ) |> addSearchFeatures( targetGroups = c("Google", "Source (Vera)"), options = searchFeaturesOptions( zoom = 9, openPopup = TRUE, position = "topleft", hideMarkerOnCollapse = TRUE ) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## Operational context Presence in the FY26 annual-stats panel and/or DDP daily population data, with best-available peak ADP, to gauge which divergences matter most. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} facility_presence <- tar_read(facility_presence) source_presence <- tar_read(source_presence) facilities_panel <- tar_read(facilities_panel) ddp_fy25_summary <- tar_read(ddp_fy25_summary) detloc_lookup <- tar_read(detloc_lookup) fy26_ids <- facility_presence |> filter(FY26) |> pull(canonical_id) ddp_ids <- source_presence |> filter(in_ddp) |> pull(canonical_id) peak_adp_panel <- facilities_panel |> group_by(canonical_id) |> summarise(peak_adp_panel = max(adp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(peak_adp_panel = ifelse(is.infinite(peak_adp_panel), NA_real_, peak_adp_panel)) ddp_adp <- ddp_fy25_summary |> inner_join(detloc_lookup, by = c("detention_facility_code" = "detloc")) |> group_by(canonical_id) |> summarise( ddp_adp = max(adp_total, na.rm = TRUE), ddp_peak = max(peak_population, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop" ) unresolved_classified <- unresolved |> mutate( in_fy26 = canonical_id %in% fy26_ids, in_ddp = canonical_id %in% ddp_ids, presence = case_when( in_fy26 & in_ddp ~ "Both FY26 + DDP", in_fy26 & !in_ddp ~ "FY26 only", !in_fy26 & in_ddp ~ "DDP only", TRUE ~ "Neither" ) ) |> left_join(peak_adp_panel, by = "canonical_id") |> left_join(ddp_adp, by = "canonical_id") |> mutate(best_peak_adp = coalesce(peak_adp_panel, ddp_peak)) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} unresolved_classified |> arrange(desc(divergence_km)) |> select( `ID` = canonical_id, `Facility` = canonical_name, `Detloc` = detloc, `Address` = facility_address, `City` = facility_city, `State` = facility_state, `Source` = source_name, `Presence` = 1030|Taylor County Adult Detention Facility |TAYLOTX |910 South 27th Street |Abilene |TX |vera_institute |DDP only | 3.1| 1| 32.4169| -99.7349| 32.4179| -99.7679| ::: ::: ## Notes on individual cases ### Migrant Ops Center Main A (404) — 662 km The largest divergence by two orders of magnitude. The facility's address is an APO/FPO routing address ("Avenue C Psc 1005 Box 55, FPO FL"), which Google resolves to a default mainland-Florida location (26.7°N, 80.9°W, near Port St. Lucie). Vera's coordinate (21.5°N, 77.8°W) is the actual Guantánamo Bay site. The Vera coordinate is correct; resolving this case means adding `GTMODCU` to the `vera_institute` group in `geocode_source_preference()`. ### The county-jail cluster (3–16 km) The remaining cases are all mainland jails, prisons, and medical facilities where Vera and Google disagree by 3–16 km — typically rural-address geocoding differences, campus-boundary ambiguity, or a stale Vera address. Each needs an individual check of which coordinate lands on the actual facility. ## Facilities with no coordinates at all Five roster facilities have neither an accepted coordinate nor enough address data to geocode. These need address research (not a source-preference decision); several are DDP-era stubs. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} facilities_geocoded_all |> filter(!divergent, is.na(lat) | is.na(lon)) |> select( `ID` = canonical_id, `Facility` = canonical_name, `Address` = facility_address, `City` = facility_city, `State` = facility_state, `Source` = source_name ) |> kable() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} | ID|Facility |Address |City |State |Source | |----:|:------------------------------|:-------|:----|:-----|:------| | 344|Southern Regional Jail |NA |NA |NA |NA | | 1204|CBP Movement Coordination Area |NA |NA |CA |NA | | 1250|Drt Cpc Holding |NA |NA |TX |NA | | 3135|Sunrise Hospital |NA |NA |NY |NA | | 3136|Spring Valley Hospital |NA |NA |NY |NA | ::: :::
